description: This file defines the MockHandler class used in GuzzleHttp for testing HTTP client code. It manages a queue of predefined responses, exceptions, or callables to simulate HTTP interactions, supporting features like callbacks for fulfilled or rejected promises, and invocation of statistics callbacks.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler class that returns predefined responses or throws exceptions from a queue for testing HTTP client behavior.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a HandlerStack with a MockHandler instance, optionally with middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional queue of responses/exceptions/callables.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an incoming request, returning a promise that resolves with a response or rejects with an exception, based on the queued responses.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds responses, exceptions, callables, or promises to the queue.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent request received.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the options associated with the most recent request.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining queued responses.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics.
